name: decimen-optical-transfer
description: Proof of concept: file transfer between two devices using fountain-coded animated QR codes — screen to camera, no network.

scripts.build:receiver:xhs:inline: npm run generate:wasm-inline && vite build --config vite.receiver-xhs-inline.config.ts
scripts.build:web: npm run build:receiver && npm run build:sender:web && npm run build:receiver:v2 && npm run build:sender:v2
scripts.build:release: npm run build:sender && npm run build:web
